description: Recommended details shape for REQUOTE_REQUIRED errors. Identifies the accepted-envelope field and change term involved and, when safe to disclose, the coarse seller-policy dimension that declined the requested shape. Producer-authored extension values remain buyer-visible and MUST NOT contain vendor identifiers, internal object names, internal IDs, stack traces, or other producer-private implementation details.

change_term_id.description: Accepted proposal change term whose typed constraint the request exceeded.
change_term_id.title: Media Buy Change Term ID

decline_reason.description: Coarse seller-policy dimension that declined the requested shape. Sellers SHOULD populate this when they have a structured reason and disclosure does not expose private thresholds or enforcement controls. When present, it MUST be consistent with the enclosing error.recovery classification.

enumDescriptions.contract_terms: The product permits the right in general, but the right was not negotiated into this buy because of account tier, insertion-order terms, or a buy-level override.
enumDescriptions.frequency_cap: The requested frequency-cap shape is incompatible with the seller's permitted exposure policy.
enumDescriptions.inventory: The seller cannot forecast or reserve the requested volume in the requested window.
enumDescriptions.minimum_commitment: The requested change would take the buy below a product-level or account-level minimum commitment.
enumDescriptions.notice_period: The change is permitted in general but was requested inside a seller notice window.
enumDescriptions.other: Another seller-policy reason; the buyer-safe error message carries the explanation.
enumDescriptions.share_of_voice: The requested change would exceed a seller concentration cap, such as an advertiser, category, or section share limit.

decline_reason.title: Seller Policy Decline Reason

envelope_field.description: Buyer-visible request field path or paths that breached the accepted commercial envelope. Values MUST NOT name seller-internal objects or identifiers. New emitters SHOULD use the array form even for one path; the scalar form remains valid for compatibility with existing 3.x sellers.

title: Requote Required Details
